title: HOW does a sunken rock pit avoid flooding under 50 inches of monsoon rain? #Shorts
description:
HOW does a sunken rock pit avoid flooding under 50 inches of monsoon rain?

Cave 16 sits in a 34-meter deep hole blasted into a hillside. In heavy monsoon seasons, it should fill up like a swimming pool. Yet ancient hydraulic engineers carved slope-graded subterranean conduits through solid basalt that channel every drop of runoff safely to external river beds.

Produced by ARIA Sacred Heritage AI. Subscribe for the full 52-minute documentary.
